title: Replication package for 'Goodness-of-Fit Indices and Diagnostics for Topic Models'
description:
Code and cached results behind every table, figure and reported number of Goodness-of-Fit Indices and Diagnostics for Topic Models (Craig M. Lewis and Francesco Grossetti; submitted to the Journal of the Royal Statistical Society, Series B) and its Supplementary Material: the four simulation studies, the MD&A empirical application, the evaluation-only revision batch and the Stage 3 computations.

Lanes (reproduce.sh): paper regenerates every exhibit exactly from the shipped caches and the deposited result objects (about two minutes); stage3 recomputes the analyses that read the fitted-model cache (about 45 minutes on 8 workers); revision reruns the evaluation-only batch (about 28 hours on 8 workers); full-sims, full-mdna and robustness refit the models (statistically equivalent, not bit-identical). install.R pins R 4.6.1, the CRAN snapshot of 2026-07-01, OpTop 0.20.1 (commit cba1273ea8) and NLPstudio 1.2.0 (commit 771b42e328).

The large objects (result objects, fitted-model cache, MD&A corpus) are deposited in a separate Zenodo data record and fetched by ./reproduce.sh fetch, which verifies every file against the checksums tracked in this repository. The harmonised support and the discrepancy indices are computed with the R package OpTop (https://github.com/contefranz/OpTop); the held-out protocols, certification rules, firm-clustered inference and residual diagnostics are implemented in this package. Code under MIT; data and results under CC0-1.0.
